title: 妈妈来了

series.next: Friday morning. 小敏 has filled in the form, and won't show anyone.

setting: A hotel lobby in 北京, midnight. 小姨 has come on the night train.

xiaoyi.name: 小姨
xiaoyi.en: 小敏's mother: furious, and frightened

yifu.name: 姨父
yifu.en: 小敏's father, at home, on the phone

steps.zh: 走远了也能回家……走远了也能回家。
steps.en: 'You can go far and still come home'... You can go far and still come home.

else.zh: 我还是不知道。可是我想知道。
else.en: I still don't know. But I want to.

steps.narr: Midnight. The hotel lobby. The night train is in.

steps.en: Where's 小敏?! She won't even answer her phone!

steps.zh: 你们两个孩子，跑这么远！
steps.en: The two of you, running off this far!

steps.zh: 北京这么大，丢了怎么办？出事了怎么办？
steps.en: 北京's enormous! What if you got lost? What if something happened?

say.en: Calm her down. Get her to sit.
answers: 小姨您别急，坐下喝口水。
say.gloss: Don't worry, Auntie. Sit down first.
say.tip: 您别急 = please don't worry: 您 for an elder, even a furious one.

ok.narr: She sits. Her hands don't stop moving.

answers: 小姨，您先消消气，坐下慢慢说。
小姨，先消消气，坐下慢慢说。
4.gloss: Auntie, let the anger out a little. Sit, and tell me slowly.
4.tip: 消消气 xiāoxiao qì = calm down (let the anger go).

steps.zh: 她爸也不管！就让她跑来北京！
steps.en: And her dad does nothing! Just lets her run off to 北京!

say.en: Explain: she only came to look. Nothing's decided.
answers: 她只是来看看，还没决定。
小敏只是来看看，还没决定呢。
say.gloss: She only came to have a look. She hasn't decided.
say.tip: 只是 zhǐshì = only, merely. 还没决定 = hasn't decided yet.

fail.en: What's she run off here for?

answers: 她只是来看看，八字还没一撇呢。
小敏只是来看看，八字还没一撇。
4.gloss: She only came to look. Nothing's even started.
4.tip: 八字还没一撇 = the character 八 hasn't got its first stroke: nothing's settled at all.

steps.narr: Outside. A 北京 street at midnight, warm, and nearly empty.

steps.zh: 我十八岁的时候，也想走。
steps.en: When I was eighteen, I wanted to leave too.

steps.zh: 我妈说不行。她说，她会想我。
steps.en: My mother said no. She said she'd miss me.
And now... it's the same with me.

steps.zh: 其实我想让她去。我以为，她爸不让。
steps.en: The truth is, I want her to go. I thought her dad wouldn't let her.

steps.narr: Footsteps. 小敏, in her pyjamas.

say.en: Stop them both: listen to me.
say.gloss: Both of you, listen to me.
say.tip: 你们俩 nǐmen liǎ = the two of you. 听我说 = hear me out.

ok.narr: They stop. They both look at you.

answers: 你们俩先停一下，听我说一句。
你们俩都停一下，听我说一句。
4.gloss: Both of you, stop a moment. Let me say one thing.

say.en: Call 姨父 so they can talk, or let 小敏 speak first.
answers: 我们给姨父打个电话吧。
say.tip: 给……打电话 = call (someone): 给姨父打个电话.

alts.gloss: Let 小敏 say it herself.

then.en: Mum. I want to go to 北京.

answers: 一家人的事，我们给姨父打个电话。
一家人的事，给姨父打个电话吧。
4.gloss: It's a family matter. Let's call 姨父.

answers: 解铃还须系铃人，让小敏自己说。
alts.gloss: Whoever tied the bell unties it: let 小敏 say it.

steps.en: One in the morning: three people on one phone call, all saying the same thing at last. 📞

else.en: 小姨 holds 小敏's hand all the way up in the lift. Neither says a word. 🌙
